svg.title: 039 fog comparison / Reader
svg.desc: Fog treatments W1–W3 are columns. Each labeled row shares one fixture and viewpoint. Story revelations through page 039.
svg.text: FOG-OF-WAR STUDIES — NOT ADOPTED / COLUMNS W1–W3 / OPEN AT FULL SIZE / REVELATIONS THROUGH 039

svg.title: Patchy contest — 039 / Before the weights reveal — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 039 / Before the weights reveal, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 hatched; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response hatched, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Propositions and observations are pictograms beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: THE WIPE SUPPORTS AN INDEPENDENCE READING. THE READING IS STILL INFERENCE.
032.5; 035.4; 038.5 / recurrence documented; independence inferred · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
